sn45.10:1.2: Then the wanderer Nandiya approached the Blessed One and exchanged greetings with him.
sn45.10:1.3: When they had concluded their greetings and cordial talk, he sat down to one side and said to the Blessed One:
sn45.10:1.4: “How many things, Master Gotama, when developed and cultivated, lead to Nibbāna, have Nibbāna as their destination, Nibbāna as their final goal?”
sn45.10:2.1: “These eight things, Nandiya, when developed and cultivated, lead to Nibbāna, have Nibbāna as their destination, Nibbāna as their final goal.
sn45.10:2.4: These eight things, when developed and cultivated, lead to Nibbāna, have Nibbāna as their destination, Nibbāna as their final goal.”
sn45.10:2.5: When this was said, the wanderer Nandiya said to the Blessed One:
sn45.10:2.7: Magnificent, Master Gotama!… From today let Master Gotama remember me as a lay follower who has gone for refuge for life.”
